projects.title: 3D Viewer
projects.description: Browser 3D model viewer for the web and Windows desktop. Load GLTF, FBX, OBJ, IFC, and more — inspect with orbit controls, GPU path tracing, HDR lighting, hotspots, and export standalone web presentations.

projects.title: 3D Viewer — from brief to WebGL
projects.description: How we turn a review problem into a shippable product — layout chrome, engineering, HDR lighting, and Streets GL city context for client decisions.

projects.title: Streets GL Bridge
projects.description: OpenStreetMap 3D ground layer integration for geolocated model presentation — sync models to real-world coordinates with terrain alignment. Live demo embeds Streets GL (MIT) for real-world OSM buildings, roads, and terrain.

projects.title: 360° Panorama Tour Editor
projects.description: 360° virtual tour editor in the browser — opens on The Black Witness by default. Load equirectangular panoramas (JPG, PNG, WebP, HDR, EXR, KTX2), place link/info/URL hotspots with optional iframe popups, build multi-scene tours, add a WebGPU birds flock effect, and save or load .360project files.

projects.title: CRM Demo
projects.description: Interactive sample CRM with fictional companies — lead pipeline, project boards, time tracking, and idea maps. Edits stay in this browser tab and never touch live client data.

projects.title: IOM Studio
projects.description: Local-first production workspace for developing characters, scripts, and shots, then routing each scene through AI generation, Blender, compositing, and delivery. Projects autosave locally and travel as branded .iomstudio files.

projects.title: Image Prep
projects.description: Browser photo prep for the web — resize to portfolio presets, compress JPEG/WebP/PNG, and strip EXIF camera and GPS data. Files stay on your device until you download them.

projects.title: The Black Witness — from brief to 360°
projects.description: Guided 360° storytelling on The Black Witness — brief, hotspot design, WebGPU effect layers, and a shareable visitor preview clients can open without an editor.

projects.title: The Black Witness
projects.description: A visual study of the same raven moving through city, forest, mountain, and mist — a silent observer crossing natural and built worlds.
galleryCaptions: Rooftop Distance — A lone raven watches the rain-softened skyline from the far edge of a wet city roof.
Alley Crossing — Between brick walls and puddled pavement, the raven moves through the alley like part of the weather.
Forest Ground — On a damp forest path, the raven pauses among wet leaves, moss, and low morning fog.
Moss Branch — Half-hidden in the old forest, the raven rests on a moss-covered branch while the trees fade into mist.
Mountain Ledge — Small against the ridges, the raven stands on wet stone as clouds move through the valley below.
Sea Cliff Watch — Above the broken surf, the raven waits on the cliff edge, almost swallowed by mist and rock.
Winter Branch — A dark wing opens against the snow, caught for a moment between landing and flight.
Abandoned Interior — Inside the ruined concrete shell, the raven appears quietly at the window, framed by water, decay, and gray light.
Valley Wall — Perched on an old stone wall, the raven becomes a small mark against the vastness of fog and hills.
Antenna Perch — On a rain-wet rooftop antenna, the raven shifts its wings above the sleeping grid of the city.

projects.title: Between Wild and Wire
projects.description: A red fox moves from forest edge to city underpass and back again, crossing the shifting boundary between wild habitat and human space.
galleryCaptions: Forest Edge at Dawn — At first light, the fox pauses where the trees give way to open ground, as if deciding whether to leave the shelter of the forest.
Misty Forest Path — On a damp woodland trail, the fox stands alert in the fog, still fully held within the quiet of the forest.
Country Path Crossing — Leaving deeper cover behind, the fox crosses a muddy track, stepping into a more open and uncertain landscape.
Industrial Edge — Among fence lines, weeds, and abandoned rails, the fox enters the outer margin of the city where nature and industry begin to overlap.
Underpass at Dusk — Beneath concrete and sodium light, the fox pauses in the damp underpass, small against the hard geometry of the built world.
Alley Crossing — In a rain-dark alley of brick and reflections, the fox moves through the city almost unnoticed, like part of the weather itself.
Park After Rain — Between wet paths, bare trees, and lit apartment towers, the fox lingers in the city's softer interior spaces.
Canal Path — Walking along the misty canal, the fox turns away from the urban core, following water and silence back toward the edges.
Frost Meadow — Out beyond the streets, the fox reenters open ground where frost, distance, and sunrise begin to restore the wild.
Forest Return — At dusk, the journey closes as the fox slips back beneath the trees, returning to the dark quiet of the forest.

projects.title: Concrete after dark
projects.description: Concrete after dark — rain, mist, and stray neon moving across brutalist walls, turning silent urban facades into cinematic fragments of light and shadow.
galleryCaptions: Monolithic Corner in Rain — A rain-darkened brutalist corner rises into dusk...
Repeating Windows in Mist — Rows of recessed windows disappear into blue twilight...
Stairwell Under Neon Rain — A deserted concrete stairwell becomes a nocturnal passage...
Slit Window Wall — A massive concrete wall with a narrow glowing window...
Elevated Walkway After Rain — An empty brutalist walkway stretches through mist...
Broad Facade at Blue Hour — A low, heavy concrete facade rests under storm clouds...
Tower in Dark Sky — A brutalist tower cuts into the night sky...
Curved Concrete in Dusk — Rounded brutalist forms and wet courtyard surfaces...
Entrance in Shadow — A shadowed concrete entrance waits under rain...
Concrete Detail with Neon — A close study of wet concrete, dark glass, seams...

projects.title: Night Grid
projects.description: City geometry after rain — reflections, sodium vapor, and the rhythm of windows as a modular grid.
galleryCaptions: Window Grid After Rain — A strict office facade becomes a grid of warm windows and dark concrete, mirrored across the rain-soaked pavement below.
Sodium Vapor Courtyard — Amber streetlights gather in the wet courtyard, turning apartment windows and rain reflections into a quiet urban pattern.
Office Grid in Blue Rain — Lit and unlit office windows form an irregular night code across a rain-darkened facade.
Underpass Reflection Grid — Beneath the concrete overhang, sodium vapor light and distant windows stretch into a wet corridor of reflections.
Modular Housing Block — A lived-in housing block glows through the night, its balconies and windows arranged like a human-scale grid.
Reflected High-Rise Pattern — The building repeats itself in the wet plaza, where window light collapses into a fractured mirror of the city.
Open Windows at Night — Private rooms interrupt the dark facade with small warm signals, each window becoming one cell in the urban grid.
Parking Deck Geometry — Empty concrete levels repeat into the rain, their amber lights reflected as broken horizontal bands.
Glass Grid and Concrete Frame — Concrete and dark glass hold the night in place, turning office light into a measured pattern of rectangles.
Distant Windows Through Mist — Across the wet rooftop, distant apartment blocks dissolve into mist, their windows fading like amber coordinates in the dark.

projects.title: Mist / Stone / Sea
projects.description: Documentary captures of coastal rock, tide, and fog — where wet surfaces, muted horizons, and sea mist reduce the landscape to texture and atmosphere.
galleryCaptions: Rocky Shore at First Light — Mist drifts across a wet stone shoreline as the sea settles into a quiet gray horizon.
Mist Cliffs — Layered sea cliffs recede into fog, where rock, surf, and sky dissolve into the same cold atmosphere.
Pebble Beach in Fog — A rain-darkened pebble beach stretches toward the water, its scattered boulders fading into coastal mist.
Tidal Pools — Black shoreline rocks hold still pools of water, reflecting the pale sky while waves break softly beyond.
Fog Jetty — A stone breakwater disappears into dense sea fog, turning distance into a quiet line of uncertainty.
Coastal Outcrop — Wet rock, dry grass, and low mist mark the edge of land before it falls into the gray sea.
Foam and Stone — Sea foam moves through dark shoreline rocks, tracing the shape of the coast in soft white lines.
Fog Island — A distant rock island emerges through the mist, barely separating itself from the muted sea and sky.
Blue-Gray Cove — Rounded shoreline stones disappear into blue-gray mist, where the surf softens every edge of the coast.

projects.title: Below the Last Light
projects.description: A solitary octopus moves through deep, half-forgotten spaces beneath the sea — shipwrecks, drowned halls, broken arches, and silent ruins touched only by faint shafts of light.
galleryCaptions: Arch in the Gloom — A lone octopus crosses the silted floor of a drowned ruin, moving beneath a broken arch where the last pale light still reaches.
Sunken Corridor — Through the narrow passage of a flooded wreck, the octopus disappears into blue darkness as if following a memory deeper inside.
Ruin Sentinel — Resting on a stone pedestal, the octopus seems less like an animal and more like a quiet keeper of the submerged hall.
Crevice Search — Pressed against the rock wall, the octopus explores a dark seam in the stone, searching for whatever the ruins still conceal.
Wreck Shadow — Suspended beside the sunken ship, the octopus drifts in open water, small against the weight and silence of the wreck.
Stair of Return — Climbing the drowned staircase, the octopus moves upward through drifting particles and thin beams of light, as if ascending into another forgotten chamber.
Chamber of Light — In the center of a vast underwater hall, the octopus becomes a small living mark beneath a single shaft of light.
Carved Passage — Along the wall of an ancient submerged corridor, the octopus lies low against the stone, blending with the ruin as if it belongs there.
Mosaic Threshold — Beside broken mosaic floors and worn steps, the octopus explores the edge of a buried room where the past still clings to the walls.
Fallen Figure — Half-hidden among columns and broken statues, the octopus peers out from the rubble like a witness to a world long drowned.

projects.title: Celestial Current
projects.description: A surreal minimal series following a manta ray adrift through space — crossing planets, rings, ruins, dust, and silence like a creature swimming through the dark between worlds.
galleryCaptions: Space Glide — A solitary manta ray drifts across open space, passing beneath a distant planet like a creature following an invisible current.
Far Crossing — Small against the scale of the cosmos, the manta becomes a quiet mark moving through vast emptiness.
Ascension Beam — Caught inside a pale shaft of light, the manta rises as if drawn upward through a celestial tide.
Monolith Encounter — Suspended before a silent black monolith, the manta seems to pause in recognition of something ancient and unknown.
Direct Approach — Facing the viewer in open space, the manta appears less like an animal and more like a calm intelligence from another realm.
Lunar Drift — Above a barren moonlit landscape, the manta floats through cold night air as if the laws of gravity no longer apply.
Starfoam — Surrounded by fields of glowing particles, the manta swims through light as though space itself had become an ocean.
Nebula Current — Against dark nebula clouds, the manta cuts a clean path through the slow weather of the cosmos.

projects.title: The Black Witness
projects.description: Cross-world raven study — city rain, forest fog, mountain stone, and coastal mist woven into a single ambient field layer.

projects.title: Between Wild and Wire
projects.description: Forest edge to city underpass and back — habitat crossing woven into a single ambient field layer for the fox journey.

projects.title: Concrete after dark
projects.description: Rain-darkened brutalist soundscape — distant neon hum, wet concrete resonance, and slow urban drift for gallery and walkthrough beds.

projects.title: Night Grid
projects.description: Sodium vapor and window-grid ambience — modular pulses, wet pavement reflections, and long-exposure city haze.

projects.title: Mist / Stone / Sea
projects.description: Coastal field layer — tide wash, fog-damped rock, and muted horizon tones for documentary and spatial experiences.

projects.title: Below the Last Light
projects.description: Submerged ruin ambience — drowned halls, faint light shafts, and the slow drift of a solitary octopus through half-forgotten spaces beneath the sea.

projects.title: Celestial Current
projects.description: Cosmic drift ambience — open silence, distant planetary hum, and the slow glide of a manta ray adrift through the dark between worlds.

projects.title: Artist Globe
projects.description: Interactive WebGL globe of photographers, painters, sculptors, sound artists, and more — filter by practice, open portfolios, highlight countries, and submit a profile for review.

projects.title: Art Gallery Space — WebGPU SSR + Denoise
projects.description: WebGPU real-time rendering of screen-space reflections with spatiotemporal denoising — load custom GLTF/FBX models, swap HDR/EXR panoramas, explore in third-person walk mode, and compare raw vs denoised reflections.

projects.title: Dream — Ocean scroll narrative
projects.description: Scroll narrative through still dark water, rain, distant land, and shore (procedural distortion with optional ambient audio crossfade), standalone weather runtime (dynamic sky, cloud layers, day/night sync), and shader-driven surface studies. Chapter 1 of 9 · work in progress.

projects.title: Volumetric Lighting — Rect Area
projects.description: Record camera views, move lights, and test lighting on different objects — import your own GLB, GLTF, or FBX (replaces the stock car). WebGPU volumetric lighting with rect area lights.

projects.title: Raven Path Animation
projects.description: Animated raven GLB following a custom Catmull-Rom path — drag spline control points, tune travel speed, ease-in/out, reverse direction, and toggle tangent-aligned vs fixed orientation while wing-flap skeletal animation plays. Import GLB/GLTF/FBX onto the path, and export or reimport path JSON for other software or your next session.

projects.title: Three.js Ocean
projects.description: Gerstner-wave ocean with procedural sky and sunset preset — glass 3D text with Google Fonts, decorative icons, wallpaper screenshots, or up to 30 seconds of WebGL video export.

projects.title: CSS3D Sprites
projects.description: 512 HTML sprites arranged in 3D space with CSS3DRenderer — morphing transitions between plane, cube, random cloud, and sphere formations with pulsing scale animation.

projects.title: Shape Particles — WebGPU Compute
projects.description: GPU compute particles arranged into shape presets — cube, sphere, torus, cone, pyramid, ring, and heart. Press Release to drop them under gravity with floor bounce, then Reset to reform the formation.

projects.title: WebGPU Spotlight
projects.description: WebGPU spot light projecting texture maps onto a scene — orbiting animated spotlight with penumbra, decay, shadow focus, and optional light helpers. Lucy PLY model on a shadow-receiving ground plane.

projects.title: WebGPU Compute Birds
projects.description: GPU flocking simulation with 8,192 instanced birds — separation, alignment, and cohesion forces computed on the GPU. Move the mouse to disturb the flock; tune behavior in Birds settings.

projects.title: WebGPU Parallax UV
projects.description: TSL parallax UV mapping on an ice ground plane — layered ambientCG textures with displacement-driven offset, overlay blending, normal and roughness maps, and HDR environment lighting.

projects.title: WebGPU TSL Raging Sea
projects.description: Procedural ocean surface with TSL wave displacement — layered large sine waves plus fractal noise, computed normals, and emissive crest highlights on a high-resolution plane mesh.

projects.title: WebGPU TSL Linked Particles
projects.description: TSL VFX particle sketch with GPU compute spawning, turbulence, nearest-neighbor link ribbons, hue rotation, and bloom post-processing. Move the pointer to draw connected particle trails.

projects.title: WebGPU Custom Fog Scattering
projects.description: Procedural pine forest silhouettes in exponential fog with TSL density-based scattering blur — first-person walk through a cool haze with tunable fog density and scattering factor.

projects.title: WebGPU Curve Modifier
projects.description: GPU curve modifier deforming extruded text along a closed Catmull-Rom spline — click control handles to select, drag to reshape the path, and watch the mesh flow along the curve.

projects.title: WebGPU Particles
projects.description: Fire and smoke instanced sprites with TSL node materials — animated life cycles, rotating smoke texture sampling, and additive fire blending over a grid ground plane.

projects.title: BufferGeometry Draw Range
projects.description: Particle network with dynamic line segments — uses BufferGeometry.setDrawRange() to render only active particles and proximity connections, with tunable count, distance, and connection limits.

projects.title: Catmull Spline Editor
projects.description: Interactive Catmull-Rom spline editor — drag control points with transform gizmos, compare uniform, centripetal, and chordal curve types, tune tension, and export Vector3 arrays for paths and camera rails.

projects.title: Terrain Sandbox
projects.description: Create procedural 3D terrain from layered noise, then place trees, rocks, and markers on the surface. Orbit, regenerate seed, tune height and roughness — a sandbox MVP toward sculpt brushes, GLTF import, and optional MapTiler real-world DEM.

projects.title: Procedural GL Terrain
projects.description: Interactive 3D real-world terrain viewer via procedural-gl.js (MPL-2.0) — GPU LOD landscapes streamed from map tiles. First step embeds the official demo; a self-hosted MapTiler-backed build can follow (API key stays out of the repo).

projects.title: Spout
projects.description: Raymarched pipe water with refraction, transparency, and reflections — drag to orbit. Self-hosted WebGL2 port of P_Malin’s classic Shadertoy experiment.
